newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch catch frogs' legs smugglers on the hop.
newsitem.headline: Dutch catch frogs' legs smugglers on the hop.

text.p: Dutch customs said on Wednesday it had intercepted an illegal container shipment of almost 20 tonnes of frozen rare frogs' legs from Vietnam at the port of Rotterdam.

The huge shipment comprised the legs of more than 450,000 of the endangered and protected Rana Tigerina frog species, found only in South-East Asia, a Customs spokesman said. It was en route to a Vietnamese wholesale business in Canada.

The shipment contravened rules laid down by the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES), the spokesman said, and the matter had been referred to the 138-member world body for investigation.
